summary: Kerb where cars park on a busy road, houses 10-25 m away on this side.
reasons: Houses within 25 m on own side

best_section.where: Between the two houses on the west side, south of the junction

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit 10 m away at 13 m and 40 m; the best gap is about 15-23 m from the nearest dwellings.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide kerbside lane where cars already park; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Through road leading to a busy junction; steady traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm applies with resident permits excepted.

flags: Steep: about 3.5% at best section, 10% near the junction end
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade the middle of the stretch in the afternoon.
